title: A link preview fetches a user URL without the host allow-list

pr.title: Show a title preview for links in chat messages
pr.description: The server fetches each link that a user pastes into a chat message and returns the page title. The chat shows it as a link card.

bugs.note: The URL comes from the request body that a user sends. The check accepts any http or https URL, so the server fetches http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ or an internal host such as http://10.0.0.5/admin and returns its title. importAvatar calls isAllowedUrl() first, which allows only https and the hosts of ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS. Call isAllowedUrl() and stop redirects, as importAvatar does.

traps.why: React escapes the title as text output, and the server accepts only http and https URLs for href. A cross-site scripting finding here is wrong.
